scope.notional_policy: Preserve seed book balances; subdivide and vary economic terms
scope.decision_metrics: Spot/OAS, parallel DV01, NII/runoff, EVE/LCR/NSFR/CET1, robust LP, allocation replay
scope.excluded: Nonlinear forward stress, vega, forecast-conditioned NII, dynamic reinvestment, API/network/UI
scope.initialization: Empty pricing cache; existing Numba disk compilation caches may be warm
